#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

class CF1187G {
public:
    vector<vector<int>> adj;
    int V, E;
    vector<int> dist, prevDist, prevEdge;
    vector<int> from, to, xorVal, w;
    vector<int> cap;
    
    vector<int> q;
    int qf, qb, ql;
    vector<bool> inq;
    
    CF1187G() {}
    
    void prepare(int n, int m) {
        adj.assign(n, vector<int>());
        dist.assign(n, INF);
        prevDist.assign(n, 0);
        prevEdge.assign(n, 0);
        from.assign(m, 0);
        to.assign(m, 0);
        xorVal.assign(m, 0);
        w.assign(m, 0);
        cap.assign(m * 2, 0);
        E = 0;
    }
    
    void addEdge(int u, int v, int c, int cost) {
        int idx = E++;
        from[idx] = u;
        to[idx] = v;
        xorVal[idx] = u ^ v;
        w[idx] = cost;
        cap[idx * 2] = c;
        adj[u].push_back(idx * 2);
        adj[v].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    void push(int x) {
        if (inq[x]) return;
        if (qf + ql == (int)q.size()) {
            if (ql * 2 <= (int)q.size()) {
                vector<int> temp(ql);
                copy(q.begin() + qf, q.begin() + qf + ql, temp.begin());
                q = temp;
                qf = 0;
            } else {
                vector<int> nq(q.size() * 2);
                copy(q.begin() + qf, q.begin() + qf + ql, nq.begin());
                q = nq;
                qf = 0;
            }
        }
        q[qf + ql++] = x;
        inq[x] = true;
    }
    
    int pop() {
        int x = q[qf++];
        ql--;
        inq[x] = false;
        return x;
    }
    
    bool spfa(int s, int t) {
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
        dist[s] = 0;
        qf = ql = 0;
        inq.assign(dist.size(), false);
        push(s);
        
        while (ql > 0) {
            int u = pop();
            int nd = prevDist[u] + 1;
            
            for (int e : adj[u]) {
                if (cap[e] > 0) {
                    int idx = e >> 1;
                    int c = (e & 1) == 0 ? w[idx] : -w[idx];
                    int ndist = dist[u] + c;
                    int v = u ^ xorVal[idx];
                    
                    if (dist[v] > ndist || (dist[v] == ndist && prevDist[v] > nd)) {
                        dist[v] = ndist;
                        prevDist[v] = nd;
                        prevEdge[v] = e;
                        push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }
    
    void augmentUnit(int s, int t) {
        for (int v = t; v != s; v ^= xorVal[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            int e = prevEdge[v];
            cap[e]--;
            cap[e ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int minCost(int s, int t) {
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            augmentUnit(s, t);
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < E; i++) {
            total += w[i] * cap[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return total;
    }
    
    void execute() {
        int n, m, k, c, d;
        cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
        
        vector<int> special(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            cin >> special[i];
            special[i]--;
        }
        
        vector<vector<int>> g(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u, v;
            cin >> u >> v;
            u--; v--;
            g[u].push_back(v);
            g[v].push_back(u);
        }
        
        int T = k + 1;
        int totalNodes = n * T + 1;
        int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (T - 1);
        prepare(totalNodes, totalEdges);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                for (int neighbor : g[i]) {
                    int v = neighbor * T + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        addEdge(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < T - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * T + t;
                int v = u + 1;
                addEdge(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            addEdge(totalNodes - 1, special[i] * T, 1, 0);
        }
        
        cout << minCost(totalNodes - 1, 0 * T + T - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.execute();
    return 0;
}
